variants.title: Give each part its job
variants.context: Multimodal AI is a system that can interpret or generate more than one form of information, such as text, images, audio, and video. A useful system does more than attach several files to one prompt: it preserves what each source observed, aligns related evidence, and makes missing or contradictory evidence visible before an output is trusted.
variants.prompt: From the lesson section “A modality is a distinct kind of evidence”: match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Text
pairs.detail: Carries instructions, retrieved context, OCR output, identifiers, and typed records.
pairs.explanation: Carries instructions, retrieved context, OCR output, identifiers, and typed records. It is compact, but a transcript or extraction can omit source detail.

pairs.label: Images
pairs.detail: Carry layout, objects, color, handwriting, charts, and spatial relationships.
pairs.explanation: Carry layout, objects, color, handwriting, charts, and spatial relationships. Resizing or cropping can remove the exact region a task needs.

pairs.label: Audio
pairs.detail: Carries speech, timing, speaker turns, and non-verbal events.
pairs.explanation: Carries speech, timing, speaker turns, and non-verbal events. Noise, overlap, accent, and transcription errors create important uncertainty.

pairs.label: Video
pairs.detail: Adds temporal order to visual evidence.
pairs.explanation: Adds temporal order to visual evidence. Frame sampling reduces cost, but a short decisive event can disappear between samples.

variants.hint: Give each part the one job only it can do, then rule out the rest. Invariant: every consequential claim must remain traceable to the source evidence and transformation that produced it.
variants.explanation: Each part has a distinct responsibility. Text: Carries instructions, retrieved context, OCR output, identifiers, and typed records. Images: Carry layout, objects, color, handwriting, charts, and spatial relationships. Audio: Carries speech, timing, speaker turns, and non-verbal events. Video: Adds temporal order to visual evidence.

variants.prompt: From the lesson section “Select a fusion pattern deliberately”: match each part to its responsibility.

pairs.label: Joint token fusion
pairs.detail: Place encoded media and text into one model context.
pairs.explanation: Place encoded media and text into one model context. This can support detailed cross-modal reasoning, but input budgets become variable and source-level conflicts may be harder to audit.

pairs.label: Evidence-level fusion
pairs.detail: Extract typed claims per modality, then compare them with provenance.
pairs.explanation: Extract typed claims per modality, then compare them with provenance. This is strong for documents, compliance, and high-impact validation.

pairs.label: Cheap-first cascade
pairs.detail: Run a bounded low-cost stage first and escalate only when required.
pairs.explanation: Run a bounded low-cost stage first and escalate only when required. The gate must be evaluated because a false negative can suppress decisive media evidence.

variants.hint: Give each part the one job only it can do, then rule out the rest. Invariant: every consequential claim must remain traceable to the source evidence and transformation that produced it.
variants.explanation: Each part has a distinct responsibility. Joint token fusion: Place encoded media and text into one model context. Evidence-level fusion: Extract typed claims per modality, then compare them with provenance. Cheap-first cascade: Run a bounded low-cost stage first and escalate only when required.

pairs.explanation: Decode media into timestamped audio windows, scene boundaries, keyframes, or task-triggered clips.

pairs.detail: Return which intervals were observed, skipped, corrupted, or below confidence so the answer does not imply complete review.

pairs.label: Document intelligence
pairs.detail: Extract fields and layout, compare them with authoritative records, and hold financial or legal conflicts before action.
pairs.explanation: Extract fields and layout, compare them with authoritative records, and hold financial or legal conflicts before action.

pairs.label: Accessible media
pairs.detail: Generate alt text, transcripts, captions, and summaries while allowing users to correct context that a model cannot observe.
pairs.explanation: Generate alt text, transcripts, captions, and summaries while allowing users to correct context that a model cannot observe.

pairs.label: Meeting intelligence
pairs.detail: Align agenda, speech, slides, decisions, owners, and timestamps.
pairs.explanation: Align agenda, speech, slides, decisions, owners, and timestamps. Avoid inferring sentiment or identity beyond the product need.

pairs.label: Visual support
pairs.detail: Help users diagnose a product or interface from screenshots while redacting credentials and disclosing when visual verification failed.
pairs.explanation: Help users diagnose a product or interface from screenshots while redacting credentials and disclosing when visual verification failed.

pairs.label: Safety inspection
pairs.detail: Preserve temporal coverage, escalate uncertain hazards, and keep humans responsible for consequential findings.
pairs.explanation: Preserve temporal coverage, escalate uncertain hazards, and keep humans responsible for consequential findings.

pairs.label: Content creation
pairs.detail: Reuse approved source material across formats with brand, rights, disclosure, and review controls around generated output.
pairs.explanation: Reuse approved source material across formats with brand, rights, disclosure, and review controls around generated output.

variants.prompt: What invariant should a production multimodal system preserve across preprocessing, fusion, and output?
options: Every modality must use the same encoder
Claims remain traceable to transformed source evidence, and missing or conflicting evidence stays visible
The model must always accept every uploaded file
All modalities must receive an equal token budget
variants.explanation: Traceability and explicit evidence limits prevent a fluent output from implying that unavailable, discarded, or contradictory media was verified.

variants.prompt: OCR reports an invoice total with 96% confidence, but the rendered page and purchase order agree on a different amount. What should happen before payment?
options: Pay the OCR amount because its confidence is highest
Average the two numeric totals
Preserve the disagreement and route the high-impact action to validation or human review
Drop the lower-confidence modalities from the trace
variants.explanation: Model confidence is not correctness, and cross-modal disagreement is operational evidence. A high-impact action should fail closed until the conflict is resolved.
